claim: Every labelled sticker in a photograph listed under one_cube lies on a single physical cube.
identity: cube_identity.photo_identity: sha256 over the sha256 of the image, then of its label file; first 16 hex digits

checks.set: clean_real.py's build: 423 train, 89 val and 89 test, from the five Roboflow projects
checks.method: Each photograph was drawn with its label boxes on contact sheets and looked at, asking whether any box lies on a second cube. None did. The largest label file has 27 rows, the most one cube can show.

checks.set: prep_heldout.py's held-out set (ml/out/heldout), one Roboflow project, every split pooled
checks.method: The same check. Every photograph shows one cube. Many of these exports pad the frame with mirrored copies of the photograph, and some boxes sit on those reflections: a reflection is the same cube's pixels, so it counts as that cube. The largest label file has 27 rows.
